name: The Throne of Lies
desc:
The Throne of Lies is the location where [Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet](entity:the_lord_regent) is fought.

It appears to be some sort of large imaginary or illusionary room made by Zi'eer, featuring [Etrea](faction:etrea)'s traditional eastern-inspired structures, with Zi'eer himself in the middle.

For more information on Zi'eer's fight, see his page.
